ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
ntpstats reads logs of ntpd, NTPsec, chrony and linuxptp, packet captures of NTP and PTP,
GNSS time-transfer and laboratory files, and network-simulator results. It computes
frequency stability with confidence intervals, time error, and an audited error bound to
UTC; measures servers with NTPv4, NTS, NTPv5 and Roughtime clients; and provides a
simulator with ground truth to benchmark synchronisation algorithms. Command line, Python
API, and a local web UI. The only runtime dependency is numpy.
about.summary: Validate, evaluate and study network time synchronisation (NTP, NTS, PTP, GNSS)

name: ntpstats
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: ntpstats
  version: "3.0.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e6ba9fe5f0e67f19bb33440ad65d6c0ee0a1784df4c523fe4de99260b76954b4

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - ntpstats = ntpstats.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.22

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - ntpstats
        - ntpstats.api
        - ntpstats.web.server
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - ntpstats --version
      - ntpstats simulate --preset lan --duration 3600 --benchmark

about:
  homepage: https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/
  repository: https://github.com/thiagodefreitas/NetworkTime
  documentation: https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/
  summary: Validate, evaluate and study network time synchronisation (NTP, NTS, PTP, GNSS)
  description: |
    ntpstats reads logs of ntpd, NTPsec, chrony and linuxptp, packet captures of NTP and PTP,
    GNSS time-transfer and laboratory files, and network-simulator results. It computes
    frequency stability with confidence intervals, time error, and an audited error bound to
    UTC; measures servers with NTPv4, NTS, NTPv5 and Roughtime clients; and provides a
    simulator with ground truth to benchmark synchronisation algorithms. Command line, Python
    API, and a local web UI. The only runtime dependency is numpy.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - NOTICE
    - src/ntpstats/web/vendor/uPlot.LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thiagodefreitas
